 Order

This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No.1223/2023, registered at Police Station-Panagar District- Jabalpur for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4, 5(1) and 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the bail application.
4. Bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
